job_spec.name: qfd_io_serdes_adapter_rxd512_pin-073694e6b-tc
job_spec.purpose: DRIVE-1143 requeue of qfd_io_serdes_adapter_rxd512_pin-c7252befb-tc (crashed: --memory-macro/--macro-view needs --stages pnr; cfg + route_master.sh now STAGES=pnr). drive-1128 2026-10-08 structural fallback, in parallel with the LVT pair: qfd_io_serdes_adapter_rxd512 TT -37.1 only on 7 r_d output ports (r_d flop -> ~440 ps of wire to the right face). PINREG=1: r_v/r_d leave through one more register at the die-RX pins (+1 cycle a word; die receiver gets OCRED+1 credits so the longer credit loop keeps full rate: RATE=1 1000/1000). Benches = the rxd512 set with PINREG=1 (exact, stall, rate, MUT and RXD 128 negatives). TC + mm FF hold HM 50, H1 SDC.
